Senior Backend Engineer (Remote)

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our payments platform team.
You will design and build services in C# and .NET, run them on Kubernetes, and
work with PostgreSQL and Kafka. Experience with React and TypeScript is a plus.

Requirements:
- 6+ years building backend services in C# and .NET
- Event-driven architecture with Kafka
- PostgreSQL performance tuning
- Kubernetes and Docker in production
- CI/CD with GitHub Actions
- Mentoring other engineers
